tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// zab bdun gshin rje 'khor lo rol pa'i lha dbang gter gzhung zur bkol bzhugs//

de nas gtso bo gzhi lus rigs bzhi dang: phyogs skyong lhu tshigs sgo ba mthil bzhi la: bstims nas so so'i phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag: hūm̐: bcom ldan dpal chen 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: mthing nag g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal: phyag drug rdo rje ral gri dgra s+t+wa g.yas: sdigs mdzub mdung thung bhan dmar g.yon gyis 'dzin: khro gtum mi bzad dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: rdo rje'i gshog pa gdengs shing zhabs bzhi bgrad: bai tā nag mo dgra s+t+wa dung dmar stob: ral gcig mthing nag rtse gsum thod khrag stob: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: dpal chen 'jam dpal yab yum dbang thob shog: oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka hūm̐: bhi dha li rak+ṣa mañdzu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: oṃ e kā dza ṭi trag rak+sha mu dra snying kha rag+mo ru lu ru lu bh+yo: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: ya ma rā dza mthing dkar dmar ba'i zhal: 'khor lo tri shul lcags kyu g.yas na 'dzin: kha ṭ+wāṃ dgra s+t+wa rgyu zhags g.yon na bsnams: g.yu yi ral gcig g.yon 'khyud rgyu zhags 'dzin: re ti ral gri ne'u le'i rkyal pa thogs: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: ya ma rā dza yab yub dbang thob shog: oṃ ya ma rā dza de wa tho la la ya ma hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ rak+mo rak+mo snying rtsa la sham bh+yo: te ma te bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: myos byed 'bar ba ser dkar nag po'i zhal: be con ral gri dgra s+t+wa g.yas na 'dzin: bhan dmar 'khor lo lcags kyu g.yon na bsnams: gtum mo dug hrul g.yon 'khyud dung dmar stob: khrag gi bdag mo spu gri tip+ta 'dzin: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: myos byed 'bar ba yab yum dbang thob shog: oṃ ya ma rā dza pre gyi ta pi si marta ka hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ rak+mo rak+mo khrag la mu sham bh+yo: ya ma de byi hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: me ru tse ni dmar dkar sngo ba'i zhal:

be con ral gri kha ṭ+wāṃ g.yas na 'dzin: bhan dmar 'khor lo rgyu zhags g.yon na bsnams: 'od zer can ma ut+pal bhan dmar stob: gling bzhi gtsug 'joms mi snying bhan+dha thogs: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: ār+ya mer tse yab yum dbang thob shog: oṃ ya ma rā dza pra ti dz+wa la hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ rag+mo rag+mo ta la ma ma bh+yo: na sha de byi hūm̐ phaṭa: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: ral pa tshar dgu ljang dkar dmar ba'i zhal: be con gtun shing rgya gram g.yas na 'dzin: bhan dmar 'khor lo rgyu zhags g.yon na bsnams: re ti g.yon 'khril khram shing bhan dmar stob: srin mo mgo 'phyang dgra s+t+wa dung dmar stob: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: ral pa tshar dgu yab yum dbang thob shog: oṃ ya ma rā tsa ka yak+ṣa sro srod ka ra hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ rak+mo rak+mo ting ting kā la ma bh+yo: kha raka de byi hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: gshin rje nag 'joms sku mdog nag: rdo rje rtse lnga g.yas la dgra s+t+wa g.yon: srin mo ral gcig nag mo kha ṭ+wāṃ dang: bhan+dha bsnams nas yab la gnyis med 'khril: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: gshin rje nag 'joms yab yum dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra ya ma rak+sha kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ ma ma rak+mo rak+mo ru lu ru lu bh+yo: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: gshin rje phywa tshangs sku mdog dkar: g.yas pas tshe bum g.yon pas thong gshol bsnams: shel gyi gdong dgu ser po ral gri dang: bhan+dha bsnams nas yab la gnyis med 'khril: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: gshin rje phywa tshangs yab yum dbang thob shog: oṃ ma hā hri ti hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ rak+mo rak+mo rak+sha ru lu ru lu bh+yo: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: gshin rje kong rje brag 'joms sku mdog dkar: g.yas pas brag ri g.yon pas me phung bsnams: brag srin shel mig dkar po lcags kyu dang: bhan+dha bsnams nas yab la gnyis med 'khril:

thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: kong rje brag 'joms yab yum dbang thob shog: oṃ ya ma ma hā san ti hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ rak+mo ru lu bh+yo: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: gshin rje a wa glang mgo smug nag 'bar: g.yas pas kha ṭ+wāṃ g.yon pas lcags kyu bsnams: bdud mo mche gtsigs smug nag me long dang: skar mda' 'phen cing yab la gnyis med 'khril: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: a wa glang mgo yab yum dbang thob shog: oṃ ya ma hrīḥku ru hūm̐: oṃ ma ma hri ti snying ru bh+yo: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: gshin rje ya ba ti ni sngo nag zhal: g.yas pas ral gri g.yon pas lcags kyu bsnams: dred kyi aṃ shaṃ nag mo khram shing dang: thod khrag 'thung zhing yab dang gnyis med 'khril: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: gshin rje ya ba ti yab yum dbang thob shog: oṃ ya ma si ti hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ ma hā rak+sha ma he ru lu bh+yo: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: gshin rje mig dmar smug nag 'bar ba'i zhal: g.yas pas ral gri g.yon pas zhing dbyug bsnams: khrag mig dmar mo gtun shing 'bar ba dang: tsit+ta 'dzin nas yab la gnyis med 'khril: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: gshin rje mig dmar yab yum dbang thob shog: oṃ ya ma a d+ya ta ra hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ rak+mo ta na ru lu bh+yo: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: gshin rje rmig pa dud kha'i mdog tu 'bar: g.yas pas thod phreng g.yon pas lcags sgrog bsnams: klu mo pus 'gro smug nag mda' gzhu dang: bhan+dha thogs nas yab la gnyis med 'khril: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: gshin rje rmig pa yab yum dbang thob shog: oṃ ma hā rak+sha hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ nā ga ru lu bh+yo: ā bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: gshin rje tel pa sngo nag 'bar ba'i zhal: g.yas pas spu gri g.yon pas dbyug to bsnams: rlung lha spyan gsum nag mo spu gri dang:

bhan+dha bsnams nas yab la gnyis med 'khril: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: gshin rje tel pa yab yum dbang thob shog: oṃ ya ma sarba pa ta hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ ba sha ma bo ru lu bh+yo: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: gshin rje bdud 'joms sku mdog smug nag 'bar: g.yas pas dgra s+t+wa g.yon pas tho ba bsnams: chu srin nag mo smug nag ral gri dang: bhan+dha khrag bkang bsnams nas yab la 'khril: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: gshin rje bdud 'joms yab yum dbang thob shog: oṃ ya ma a baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ yak+ṣa yag+mo ru lu ru lu bh+yo: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: gshin rje chos rgyal dkar la ser ba'i mdog: rdo rje rtse gsum g.yas la khram shing g.yon: nam gru ser mo las kyi me long dang: nyi zer thod khrag bsnams nas yab la 'khril: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: gshin rje chos rgyal yab yum dbang thob shog: oṃ ya ma dharma rā tsa hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ ma ma e ke rak+mo bh+yo: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: gshin rje 'bar ba dmar nag 'bar ba'i zhal: khram shing g.yas la rtsis kyi byang bu g.yon: nag mo mgo dgu dmar nag rtse gsum dang: bhan+dha khrag bkang bsnams nas yab la 'khril: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: gshin rje 'bar ba yab yum dbang thob shog: oṃ ya ma de wa dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ ya ma rak+mo ru lu bh+yo: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: gshin rje thod dbyug sku mdog nag po'i zhal: ro yi dbyug pa rtsis kyi rdil bu bsnams: sa bdag nag mo phag mgo rdo rje'i zhags: bhan+dha bsnams nas yab la gnyis med 'khril: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: gshin rje thod dbyug yab yum dbang thob shog: oṃ ya ma tri ti baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ kā la rak+mo ru lu bh+yo: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: sgo ba dung gi bya rgod mgo can dkar: g.yas pas rdo rje g.yon pas lcags kyu 'dzin:

thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: dung gi bya rgod mgo can dbang thob shog: oṃ ya ma aṃ ku sha dza: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: sgo ba gser gyi stag mgo ser nag 'bar: g.yas pas rin chen g.yon pas zhags pa 'dzin: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: sgo ba gser gyi stag mgo'i dbang thob shog: oṃ ya ma pā sha hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: sgo ba bswe yi kaṅka'i mgo can dmar: g.yas pas pad+ma g.yon pas lcags sgrog 'dzin: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: bswe yi kaṅka'i mgo can dbang thob shog: oṃ ya ma s+pho ṭa baṃ: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: sgo ba lcags kyi spyang mgo ljang nag 'bar: g.yas pas rgya gram g.yon pas dril bu 'dzin: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: sgo ba lcags kyi spyang mo'i dbang thob shog: oṃ ya ma gaṇ+ḍe ho: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: nam mkha' mdzod nas kho bo mchog gyur gling pas spyan drangs pa'o/// /
